title: Rocuronium — Pediatric RSI Paralysis
purpose: Non-depolarizing paralytic for RSI. Default when succinylcholine is contraindicated; reversible with sugammadec.

doses.notes: Onset ~45-60 s at RSI dose, duration 30-60 min. No fasciculations, no hyperkalemia risk.

reversal: Sugammadex 16 mg/kg for immediate reversal of an RSI dose.
buildNote: Succinylcholine (1-2 mg/kg IV, max 150 mg) is the faster-onset/shorter-duration alternative — contraindicated with hyperkalemia risk, myopathy, or MH history. Add that card and cross-link.
